description: mta_sts_mx.rs line 16: mx.strip_suffix(suffix.as_str()) — suffix is a String, which auto-derefs to &str via Deref<Target=str>. The explicit .as_str() call is redundant (clippy::explicit_auto_deref / needless_as_str). Use &suffix or just suffix.as_str() replaced by letting Deref coerce. No engineering consequence, but it signals unfamiliarity with Deref coercions.
title: mta_sts_mx.rs: redundant .as_str() call on String
